verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is API-first: the engine exposes search and conversational features through a single API, publishes an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec for its REST API, and supports creating indexes, adding documents, configuring settings and searching programmatically. No document explicitly states parity with the UI, and the Cloud web-interface steps (setting up Cloud, creating a project) have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of Cloud project and account management, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API
you can create indexes, add documents, configure settings, and perform searches using natural language prompts
Meilisearch publishes its engine's OpenAPI 3.1.0 document on the docs site
Typed SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart, and .NET.
